components.css: .ds-loop{font-family:var(--font-body,"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);color:var(--text-primary,#172c46);padding:30px 0 20px}.ds-loop-path{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 26px 1fr 26px 1fr 26px 1fr 26px 1fr;gap:5px 12px;align-items:center}.ds-loop button{min-height:56px;padding:12px 10px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary,#445671);font:500 15px/1.5 var(--font-body,"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-loop button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--surface-1,#fff);color:var(--text-primary,#172c46)}.ds-loop button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2865b1);outline-offset:4px}.ds-loop-path>span{color:var(--text-muted,#53647a)}.ds-loop-path>p{grid-column:1/6;grid-row:2;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-muted,#53647a);text-align:center;padding-top:12px}.ds-loop-explanation{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;margin-top:26px}.ds-loop-explanation p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;max-width:65ch;min-height:48px;color:var(--text-secondary,#445671);margin:0}.ds-loop-explanation>span{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted,#53647a);white-space:nowrap}@media(hover:hover){.ds-loop button:hover{background:var(--surface-1,#fff);color:var(--text-primary,#172c46)}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-loop-path{grid-template-columns:1fr 22px 1fr 22px 1fr;gap:7px}.ds-loop button{font-size:12px;padding:12px 5px}.ds-loop-path>span:nth-of-type(3){display:none}.ds-loop-path>button:nth-of-type(4){grid-column:1;grid-row:3}.ds-loop-path>span:nth-of-type(4){grid-column:2;grid-row:3}.ds-loop-path>button:nth-of-type(5){grid-column:3;grid-row:3}.ds-loop-path>p{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:2;text-align:left;font-size:9px}.ds-loop-explanation p{font-size:12px;min-height:80px}}

narrative.northStar: The supplied identity, direct access to research.
narrative.overview: Original navy identity on porcelain and mist blue, with a full-window animated hero. Results span the browser without enclosing cards: ranking, safety/quality, people outcomes and single-model scenario bars. Comparison tables stay off results. Complete searchable documentation is hosted locally.
keyCharacteristics: Original navy emblem and local fonts
rules: Do not restore evacuation-grid or replay UI.
Keep published results and scientific qualifications unchanged.
Do not embed comparison tables or comparison selectors on results.
Keep results full width with open chart sections.
Documentation links open local complete guides.
dos: Preserve keyboard, touch and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not add future products or claims.
Do not introduce decorative AI imagery or a dark theme.
